end.summary: Discussed physical changes as changes in state, shape or size without a new substance.
end.parentNote: Ananya practised identifying melting ghee, melting ice and breaking chalk as physical changes, using reversibility and “no new substance” as the method. They explained that ghee can melt and solidify again and connected this to changes in hair arrangement. Ananya remained unsure about whether cooking chapati is physical or chemical; this was not corrected by the end of the lesson. At home, ask them to sort examples into physical or chemical changes and give one reason for each.
